crop.notes: includes the following 'COMMERCE' section heading; the 'Sporting' column heading is just above the crop

title.suggested: Tom Allen Offers to Fight Coburn or O'Baldwin

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported from New York that Joe Coburn challenged Jem Mace for $10,000 and that Tom Allen offered to fight Coburn for $5,000 or O'Baldwin for $1,000.

metadata.notes: page header reads 'The Missouri Republican--St. Louis May 15, 1871'; dispatch dated New York, May 14

facts.fact: A New York dispatch reported that Allen offered to fight Joe Coburn for $5,000 or Ned O'Baldwin for $1,000

notes: The current title and summary are wrong: there is no Mace interview, only a two-sentence telegraph item. Same dispatch as article 431; Allen denied the challenge in article 433.
